title: Thread encoder activation readiness into capability evidence
summary: Threaded descriptor activation readiness into the read-only encoder capability report and Launch/Settings evidence. Available encoders that are not active for descriptor-owned attempts now remain review-only evidence and are excluded from derived Python EncodingCapabilityFacts, preserving dormant AV1/NVENC hardware fail-closed behavior.
reason: Advance encoder breadth/AV1 readiness without activating new hardware families or changing FFmpeg command generation: operator surfaces should distinguish executable descriptor activation from raw FFmpeg availability.
behavior_before: The encoder capability report exposed selected primary/fallback rows and raw availability, and Python derived EncodingCapabilityFacts from available rows without knowing whether descriptor-owned flags were active for that attempt.
behavior_after: Capability report rows include per-role descriptor activation evidence. Settings workspace and Launch preflight expose active, available-inactive, and activation-unknown encoder counts; Python capability facts are derived only from available rows that are active for descriptor-owned attempts when activation evidence is present.
tests_added: Added PowerShell coverage proving AV1/NVENC capability rows remain inactive while AV1/libaom CPU fallback rows are active in the descriptor capability report.
Added Settings policy coverage proving available-but-inactive encoder rows are review evidence and excluded from derived EncodingCapabilityFacts.
Added Launch preflight coverage proving active/inactive encoder counts are surfaced as read-only evidence.
rollback_plan: Remove activation fields from New-MediaEncoderCapabilityReport rows, restore Settings/Launch evidence to raw availability-only summaries, remove the targeted tests, refresh generated summaries, and rerun the same Python and PowerShell encoder evidence checks.
notes:
Added read-only descriptor activation evidence to encoder capability report rows.
Threaded activation-aware encoder capability facts and active/inactive report summaries.
Carried encoder active/inactive counts into Launch preflight read-only detail.
Covered AV1/NVENC dormant primary and AV1 CPU fallback activation evidence in capability reports.
Covered activation-aware Settings capability facts and inactive available encoder summaries.
Covered Launch preflight active/inactive encoder capability evidence.
Updated current encoder breadth status with activation-aware capability evidence.
Updated open encoder breadth workstream status with activation-aware capability evidence.
Refreshed generated summary.
